text: Did you know the smoothest balls on Earth are made by smashing them?
sayTts: [mischievously] Did you know the smoothest balls on Earth... are made by smashing them?

text: Relax. Today I'll show you how.
sayTts: [playfully] Relax. Today I'll show you how.

text: A 20-ton punch, an 840-degree oven… and a fourth step that makes them almost perfect.
say: A twenty-ton punch, an eight-hundred-forty-degree oven… and a fourth step that makes them almost perfect.
sayTts: [curious] A twenty-ton punch, an eight-hundred-forty-degree oven… and a fourth step that makes them almost perfect.

text: A bearing ball is hard, round, shiny steel. And everything that spins needs a pair… or a hundred.
sayTts: [chuckles] A bearing ball is hard, round, shiny steel. And everything that spins needs a pair… [laughs] or a hundred.

text: But how do they get them so round?
sayTts: [curious] But how do they get them so round?

text: Step one: chunks of wire, slammed between two cups.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step one: chunks of wire, slammed between two cups!

text: Up to 20 tons per hit. It comes out with a ring, like Saturn.
say: Up to twenty tons per hit. It comes out with a ring, like Saturn.
sayTts: [amazed] Up to twenty tons per hit! It comes out with a ring, like Saturn.

text: Step two: they roll between grooved plates until the ring is gone.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step two: they roll between grooved plates until the ring is gone.

text: And yes: the more they rub them, the harder they get.
sayTts: [chuckles] And yes: the more they rub them... the harder they get.

text: Step three: an 840-degree oven, then an oil bath.
say: Step three: an eight-hundred-forty-degree oven, then an oil bath.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step three: an eight-hundred-forty-degree oven, then an oil bath!

text: If the hardening fails, it stays soft, and the bearing wears out fast.
sayTts: [whispers] If the hardening fails, it stays soft... and the bearing wears out fast.

text: Look at what someone commented:

comment.question: Why make them that perfect if nobody sees them?

sayTts: [playfully] Look at what someone commented:

text: Why make them that perfect if nobody sees them?

comment.question: Why make them that perfect if nobody sees them?

sayTts: [sarcastic] Why make them that perfect if nobody sees them?

text: Because they spin thousands of times a minute. One bump, and everything shakes.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Because they spin thousands of times a minute. One bump... and everything shakes.

text: So, step four: lapping, with softer plates and a fine abrasive paste.
sayTts: [excited] So, step four: lapping, with softer plates and a fine abrasive paste.

text: In the end, they're off a perfect sphere by just 80 nanometers.
say: In the end, they're off a perfect sphere by just eighty nanometers.
sayTts: [amazed] In the end, they're off a perfect sphere... by just eighty nanometers!

text: Blow a one-centimeter ball up to Earth size, and its tallest mountain is a 30-story building.
say: Blow a one-centimeter ball up to Earth size, and its tallest mountain is a thirty-story building.
sayTts: [gasps] Blow a one-centimeter ball up to Earth size, and its tallest mountain is a thirty-story building!

text: Then they're sorted by size: every ball in a bearing is a twin.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Then they're sorted by size: every ball in a bearing is a twin.

text: Before: a scrap of wire. Now: a perfect ball with your friend's name on it.
sayTts: [excited] Before: a scrap of wire. Now: a perfect ball with your friend's name on it!

text: Tag or send this to your friend who brags that theirs are perfect.
sayTts: [mischievously] Tag or send this to your friend who brags... that theirs are perfect.

text: See you next time! Hit like and follow for more breakdowns like this.
sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more breakdowns like this.
